title: The Soul of Modesty
description: In this sermon titled "The Soul of Modesty" by C.J. Mahaney, he addresses the issue of how women's clothing choices can distract men from worshiping and serving God. He emphasizes the importance of modesty in attire, urging women to dress in a way that is self-controlled and respectable. Mahaney highlights the continuous temptation towards lust that men face and asks women to help deter this temptation by dressing modestly. He also encourages women to focus more on spiritual adornment through good works rather than excessive attention to appearance.
